subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate preposition:

The researchers accounted ___________ all variables before finalizing the data model.
solution:
The correct answer is '**for**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrasal verb "**account for**" means to consider or include something when calculating or analyzing a situation.
 
• In the given context, the researchers considered all variables while finalizing the data model.
